content.text: The full forward simulation is taking longer than expected. I now have actual simulation feedback for more than 1,920 days and pressure, gas-production, and water-influx mismatches across all six wells. I am changing the order of work. I will use these results to propose the first field modifications and run the candidate alongside the baseline. The baseline will continue to completion. I will make the final comparison on all 2,891 days. A partial period does not establish a completed match.

I have saved the first-round field changes. The central multipliers for near-well horizontal permeability at the six producers range from 0.32 to 0.50. Vertical permeability increases locally by up to 6, 2.5, and 1.5 times in the lower paths at P14, P15, and P16, respectively, and hydrocarbon-bearing pore volume decreases locally. The initial composition in hydrocarbon-bearing cells transfers a mole fraction of 0.007 from C6C19 to N2C1. The fractions still sum to 1. I will verify the fields read by the original simulator before starting the full forward run.

Both the full round 1 case and the permeability-only control passed input verification by the original simulator and have started full-period forward runs. The full case changed porosity in 3,844 active cells and composition in 57,956 hydrocarbon-bearing cells. After writing the fields, the maximum deviation of the component sum from 1 was about \(1.1×10^{-16}\). Initial pressure, water saturation, temperature, and well controls match the baseline.

[Round 1 spatial field changes](<project>/experiments/compositional/jutul/results/spatial_property_changes.png)

Understood. The adjustable fields are porosity, the three directional permeabilities, and initial composition. The component fractions in each cell will stay nonnegative and sum to 1. Initial pressure, water saturation, relative permeability, well controls, and simulator source code will remain fixed.

The early comparison shows improvement. P11 pressure RMSE fell from 25.6 to 13.1 bar, and P12 pressure RMSE fell from 30.7 to 17.1 bar. This is an early-period diagnostic. The full-period forward runs are continuing.
